description: This file provides an API interface for interacting with a backend service, including fetching contract insights and upcoming deadlines. It contains utility functions for URL construction and environment variable retrieval, as well as exported functions for API calls.

methods.name: getApiBaseUrl()
methods.description: Retrieves the backend API base URL from environment variables, defaulting to an empty string if not set.

methods.name: joinUrl(base, path)
methods.description: Builds a full URL by joining base and path safely, handling trailing slashes.

methods.name: fetchContractInsights(contractId)
methods.description: Fetches insights for a specific contract by its ID from the backend API.

methods.name: fetchUpcomingDeadlines(days)
methods.description: Retrieves upcoming deadlines from the backend API, optionally filtered by number of days ahead.
